description: `prompt-manager team decision-show <team> <id>` default human output shows decision / rationale / context / status but omits the options block. To see what --selected values are valid, the operator must re-run with --json. This breaks the human-first CLI-consumption principle from skill-principles. When a decision has an options array, human output should display each option's key / label / rationale / recommended flag — either always or behind a --full flag. Surfaced 2026-04-24 walk during Phase 5.5 when executing decisions requires knowing the option keys.
name: prompt-manager-decision-show-options-default-output
title: decision-show default human output should display options block
